dim.description: the dimension in which we index
constraints: dim must be less than rank(input)
index values must be in range [0, input.size[dim])

index.description: the 1-D tensor containing the indices to index
constraints: index dtype must be int32 or int64
index values must be in range [0, input.size[dim])

output.description: Returns a new tensor which indexes the input tensor along dimension dim. The returned tensor has the same number of dimensions as the original tensor (input). The dim th dimension has the same size as the length of index; other dimensions have the same size as in the original tensor.

constraints: index values must be in range [0, input.size[dim])
